findings.namedBuyers: Two verified named relationship-entry contacts: Claire Damary, Chargée de projets Salon du livre, is the published exhibitor-project contact (claire.damary@palexpo.ch; +41 22 761 10 72); Natacha Bayard, directrice du salon, is a senior organizer contact reachable through the general event channel info@salondulivre.ch / +41 22 761 11 11. Neither is publicly established as hotel-contract signatory or housing buyer. Nine Simon is also verified as artistic director, relevant principally to programme/guest referral. No named lodging manager was found.
findings.futureEdition: Officially announced upcoming edition: 24–28 February 2027, not historical dates. The June 2026 exhibition regulations state: “L’exposition aura lieu à PALEXPO du mercredi 24 au dimanche 28 février 2027.” The official event listing independently agrees. No exact officially announced 2028 edition dates were located; do not convert annual recurrence or a third-party tentative listing into confirmed 2028 dates.
findings.hotelProductFit: Assessment/inference using the supplied hotel constraints: YOTEL Geneva Lake is a Founex/La Côte airport-corridor satellite option, not the host venue or a downtown hotel. Its 237 rooms and six meeting rooms suit a separately identified publisher/exhibitor team or small ancillary briefing, not primary housing for the entire fair. A proposed 20–120-room block would be a hotel-side sales envelope only, not evidenced demand; start with actual team requirements rather than assuming that scale. The only specifically evidenced lodging cohort has 12 fellowship places and a Cornavin-adjacent hotel arrangement, making it both below the normal block guidance and geographically unsuitable for YOTEL under the published programme. Airport access is a logistical advantage, not evidence that attendees lodge in La Côte. The hotel publishes an airport shuttle, but no dedicated Salon/Palexpo transfer or event-capacity guarantee was verified. Confirm late-evening transfers and catering before offering any package; banquet capacity remains unverified. This is not a resort-retreat-led event.
findings.venueCommitments: Confirmed exhibition venue: Palexpo, Route François-Peyrot 30, 1218 Le Grand-Saconnex, canton of Geneva, Switzerland. Territory: Geneva Airport corridor, not Founex/Nyon/La Côte and not central Geneva. This is an exhibition centre, not a competing hotel. Hall allocation for 2027 is unsupported. The venue commitment does not establish a hotel allotment.
findings.historicalRotation: Not an itinerant destination-rotation series: official history describes a pandemic-era city format in 2020–2022 and return to the historical Palexpo setting in 2023. The 2022 edition occupied Geneva cultural venues, centred on Promenade de la Treille; 2023–2026 returned to Palexpo. The 2027 edition moves from recent March scheduling to February; dates must not be extrapolated from earlier years. No historical host hotel was identified.
findings.accommodationSourcing: Two distinct mechanisms. (1) General event housing: unknown. Palexpo offers a standing Hotel Reservation service, including “la pré-réservation d’un contingent de chambres” and an online booking tool; contact info@palexpohotelreservation.ch, +41 22 761 10 11. This generic capability is not proof that the 2027 Salon appointed it, reserved rooms, or opened hotel sourcing. (2) Confirmed edition-specific lodging provision: the 24–26 February 2027 francophone booksellers fellowship, jointly supported by the Salon and LivreSuisse, advertises 12 places and “Deux nuits d’hôtel, soit mercredi soir et jeudi soir (réservées par le fellowship).” The hotel is unnamed, five minutes on foot from Genève-Cornavin; covered nights are 24 and 25 February. This is organizer-arranged city lodging, not independently bookable demand. No room count, room-night total, rate, signed contract, housing RFP or named hotel list was located. The public 2027 regulations refer exhibitors to a separate portal and event circulars; any private housing instructions remain unverified.
findings.organizationStructure: The 2027 regulations identify PALEXPO SA, a société anonyme, as organizer and owner/operator of the exhibition and congress facility. This is a corporate-organized cultural/public exhibition with a professional publishing programme, not an association congress or sports event. Venue operator and event organizer are the same corporate entity, but hotel buyer remains a separate unresolved role. LivreSuisse collaborates on the fellowship; that does not establish control of all event lodging. No external PCO/DMC appointment was located.
findings.competitiveLimitations: The fellowship already specifies organizer-reserved city hotel nights, property unnamed; its Cornavin requirement is a concrete location disadvantage for Founex. No named 2027 incumbent hotel, exclusive hotel agreement, public general room block, sell-out, overflow requirement or unmet demand was found. Palexpo’s generic housing service must not be treated as an appointed 2027 bureau. B&B HOTELS markets accommodation around the Salon generically, but that is neither a 2027 booking commitment nor a preferred-hotel appointment. No hotels are named in the reviewed edition-specific housing material. The regulations also reserve on-site catering to Palexpo Restaurants/approved partners; this is not evidence of off-site meeting demand.
findings.recommendedSalesAction: First contact Claire Damary through her published business email/telephone and request referral to the person actually managing exhibitor/guest accommodation, copying or seeking escalation to Natacha Bayard through the event inbox. Ask whether a 2027 housing circular exists, whether Palexpo Hotel Reservation is appointed, which cohorts book independently, and whether any named team wants Founex lodging. Separately ask the housing-service inbox about event-specific hotel onboarding; do not imply appointment. Only after a buyer confirms overnight needs and geography, prepare a modest team-block proposal with a priced, validated Palexpo transfer solution and verified catering. If all lodging is centralized or Cornavin-bound, close current-edition sales pursuit and seek the next procurement review date.
findings.currentEditionAccessibility: For the 2027 edition, hotel-sales accessibility is unconfirmed, not open. The fellowship’s published lodging arrangement is not a credible YOTEL capture target without an explicit change of geography and procurement. Other exhibitor/author/team demand may exist, but independent booking rights, overnight volume and willingness to stay in Founex are not evidenced. Therefore retain only a conditional satellite relationship lead, not a qualified room-block opportunity.
findings.futureCompetitiveCapturePotential: Inference: verified recurrence supports relationship development for later editions, not guaranteed accommodation demand or an open future tender. Ask to be considered for independently sourced publisher/exhibitor teams or an airport-oriented satellite allotment at the next documented sourcing cycle. Do not pursue relocation of the fair itself or displace the Cornavin fellowship proposition without buyer confirmation. No exact 2028 dates, hotel procurement timetable or future RFP were officially located.
